chromosom.definition: one packaged unit of a cell's DNA

nucl_acid.definition: an information-carrying macromolecule built of nucleotide chains

protein.definition: a macromolecule made of amino-acid (polypeptide) chains

deoxyribonucl_acid_dna.definition: the usually double-stranded nucleic acid storing genetic information

type_iir.definition: the avirulent strain lacking a capsule

deoxyribonucleas_dnas.definition: an enzyme that cuts up DNA

ribonucleas_rnas.definition: an enzyme that cuts up RNA

proteas.definition: an enzyme that cuts up proteins

bacteriophag_t2.definition: a virus that infects E. coli bacteria

tobacc_mosa_viru_tmv.definition: a plant virus: RNA in a protein coat

chromatin.definition: the DNA–protein complex that chromosomes are made of

plasmid.definition: a small extra DNA circle in bacteria

contour.definition: its full stretched-out length, measured along the curve

diameter.definition: its width straight through the center

deterg.definition: soap-like chemicals that dissolve membranes, bursting cells open

polyc.definition: a molecule carrying many positive charges

haploid.definition: having just one complete set of chromosomes

satellit_dnas.definition: the minor, repetitive fractions beside the main band

constit.definition: a component part of a whole

dna_duplex.definition: a DNA molecule of two paired strands

in_situ_hybridiz.definition: locating a DNA sequence directly on the chromosome

transposon.definition: DNA segments that jump around the genome

euchromatin.definition: the loosely packed chromatin that stains lightly

germ_line_cell.definition: the cells that make eggs or sperm

theor.definition: a broad, testable explanation that organizes observations

principl.definition: a statement like a law, but less general

interpolat.definition: to estimate between a scale's smallest divisions

estimat_uncertaint.definition: the stated ± it might be off by

unit.definition: the named amount a measurement is expressed in

standard.definition: the agreed physical reference defining a unit exactly

base_quant.definition: defined by its own standard, not other quantities

deriv_quant.definition: quantities defined in terms of the base quantities

oper_defin.definition: a definition that specifies a rule or procedure

order_of_magnitud_estimat.definition: a rough estimate rounded to powers of ten

perc_uncertaint.definition: the uncertainty over the measured value, × 100
